13.title: 第13讲 动词的时和体（一）

items.stem: Mr. White works with a chemicals import & export company, but he ______ for this industrial fair, since he is on leave.
items.note: 他平时在那家公司上班。现在休假，暂时在博览会做事，所以用 is working。

items.stem: How can I ever concentrate if you _____ continually _____ me with silly questions?
items.note: continually 是在嫌对方老问。这种带情绪的“老是”，用 are interrupting。

items.stem: It's high time we ______ cutting down the rainforests.
items.note: It's high time 后面说现在就该停。用 stopped，不加 will。

items.stem: Which of the italicized parts expresses a future tense?

opts.t: My friend teaches chemistry in a school.
I'll give it to you after I return.
What is the matter with you?
London stands on the River Thames.

items.note: 还书是以后的事。after 后面却用 return，不加 will。will 在前面那句。

items.stem: Which of the following sentences expresses a future action?

opts.t: Lucy is continually finding fault with her sister.
We are meeting the visitors after the performance.
The coach is now crossing the Garden Bridge.
I'm hoping that you'll give us some advice.

items.note: 演出之后要见客人，是已经安排好的以后的事，用 are meeting。

items.stem: It's getting late. I'd rather you ______ now.
items.note: I'd rather you 后面说希望你现在就走，用 left。

items.stem: In his plays Shakespeare ______ his characters live through their language.
items.note: 莎士比亚是过去的人。说到他的剧本现在还这样，用 makes。

items.stem: He would have finished his college education, but he ______ to quit and find a job to support his family.
items.note: 前面 would have finished 是没做成的假想。but 后面是真发生过的事，用 had。

items.stem: If only I ______ play the guitar as well as you!
items.note: 希望自己吉他能弹得一样好。说的是能力，用 could。

items.stem: What is the function of the present progressive in "They are always calling me by the wrong name"?
items.note: 不是在说他们此刻正在叫。always 是嫌对方老叫错名字。

items.stem: What is the function of the present progressive in "My neighbor is always playing loud music at midnight"?
items.note: 同样是嫌邻居半夜吵，不是平平常常的正在放音乐。

items.stem: "It is taking forever to upload an album." The underlined part expresses ______.
items.note: taking forever 是在抱怨上传太慢。
